evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present NER-D, a cross-domain benchmark for German NER comprising 13 datasets spanning 9 domains, including General/Politics, Wikipedia, Legal, Medical, Historical, Financial, Agriculture and Archaeology.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We further analyze the influence of the domain and the tagset used in each task on the performance achieved in the different evaluation settings.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Our results show that without any sort of optimization a proprietary model (GPT-5.4 mini) outperforms the smaller open-source models on 6 out of 13 datasets, but LoRA fine-tuning enables the smaller models to substantially outperform the proprietary baseline.
